definition: I. רֶ֫סֶן noun masculine Isa 30:28 : 1. halter ; 2. jaw (?); — 1. absolute ׳ ר Ps 32:9 restraining mouth of horse or ass (+ מֶתֶג ); figurative of ׳ שֵׁם י , עַללְֿחָיֵי עַמִּים ׳ ר Isa 30:28 מִפָּנַי שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ ׳ ר Job 30:11 , i.e. threw off restraint. 2. suffix כֶּפֶל רִסְנוֺ Job 41:5 the double of his jaw , his double jaws (of croc.), si vera 1.; connection of meanings strange, || פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֺ , whence GHBW right Du conjecture סִיֹנוֺ .

I. רֶ֫סֶן noun masculineIsa 30:28:

1. halter;
2. jaw (?); —
1. absolute ׳ר Ps 32:9 restraining mouth of horse or ass (+מֶתֶג); figurative of ׳שֵׁם י, עַללְֿחָיֵי עַמִּים׳ר Isa 30:28 מִפָּנַי שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ ׳ר Job 30:11, i.e. threw off restraint.
2. suffix כֶּפֶל רִסְנוֺ Job 41:5 the double of his jaw, his double jaws (of croc.), si vera 1.; connection of meanings strange, || פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֺ, whence GHBW right Du conjecture סִיֹנוֺ.
